profile.summary: K2A Architecture + Interiors is an architecture and interior design firm based in San Francisco, with an office in Oakland. It provides design services from site investigation and planning through construction documents and construction administration. Its work includes schools, colleges and other public projects in the San Francisco Bay Area.

review.notes: This is the same organization OUSD contracts with. The firm's site k2architects.com uses the name K2A Architecture, links to a LinkedIn page called 'K2A Architecture + Interiors' and a Facebook handle 'k2allp', lists an Oakland office at 610 16th St matching the agenda, and shows school projects that fit OUSD's architectural services contracts. Every field is backed by a cited page: the contact page gives San Francisco as the main office and phone 415.487.6900, and the profile and projects pages support the neutral summary of full-range architecture and interior design services for school, college and public projects in the Bay Area.
